@deskSysNoticeTitle.description: Title of the operating system's notification when a payment arrives while the wallet window is not in front. The body is the same sentence as the in-app notice.

@deskSysNoticeOpen.description: Label of the default action of the Linux notification (clicking it opens the wallet and the payment).

@deskSetSystemNotices.description: Settings row (Appearance): a switch for showing an arriving payment as the system's notification while the wallet window is not in front.

deskSetSynSystemNotices: notifications, alerts, toast, banner, desktop notification, payment received, popup

@deskSetSynSystemNotices.description: Settings search: other words that find the “System notifications” row, comma-separated, lower case. Use words people type in this language (English ones that are used as they are may stay). Not shown.
